# Garmops

> Garmops is a B2B custom apparel and branded merchandise manufacturer and online ordering platform operated by Moist Corp in Greater Noida, India.

Garmops helps brands, startups, companies, hospitality teams, creative studios, sports organisations, artists and event organisers produce custom apparel in bulk. The minimum custom order is 50 pieces per style. Standard delivery is 35 days from order confirmation, and an 18-day rush option is available for feasible orders.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.garmops.com/index.md): Company overview, industries served, key order facts and common questions.
- [Bulk custom T-shirt printing](https://www.garmops.com/custom-t-shirt-printing/index.md): 200 GSM and 260 GSM custom T-shirts in regular and boxy fits from 50 pieces.
- [Custom polo T-shirts](https://www.garmops.com/custom-polo-t-shirts/index.md): Custom 280 GSM cotton-pique polos for company, staff and hospitality teams.
- [Custom hoodies](https://www.garmops.com/custom-hoodies/index.md): Regular- and boxy-fit 320 GSM custom hoodies for companies, teams and merchandise.
- [Custom tote bags](https://www.garmops.com/custom-tote-bags/index.md): Printed 12 oz canvas tote bags for companies, events and merchandise ranges.
- [Corporate merchandise](https://www.garmops.com/corporate-merchandise/index.md): Branded employee apparel for onboarding, events and company programmes.
- [Hospitality apparel](https://www.garmops.com/industries/hospitality/index.md): Restaurant staff apparel and cafe or hospitality merchandise.
- [Event merchandise](https://www.garmops.com/industries/events/index.md): Custom apparel and totes for conferences, festivals, launches and artist merchandise.
- [Products](https://www.garmops.com/products/index.md): Samples and specifications for T-shirts, polos, hoodies, sweatshirts, long-sleeve tees and canvas totes.
- [Online configurator guide](https://www.garmops.com/configurator/index.md): Select a garment, colour, artwork position, decoration and neck-label options.
- [Pricing](https://www.garmops.com/pricing/index.md): Current product pricing, inclusions, quantity discounts, GST and rush options.
- [Case studies](https://www.garmops.com/work/index.md): Custom merchandise case studies.
- [Guides](https://www.garmops.com/journal/index.md): Production-led custom apparel and merchandise guides.
- [About](https://www.garmops.com/about/index.md): Garmops identity, location, products and operating facts.
- [Contact](https://www.garmops.com/contact/index.md): Request a production-ready custom apparel quote.
